conservation.report_notes: Published with corresponding artwork entry in *Georgia O’Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné* (Lynes, 1999), this historical conservation information documents treatment decisions made during the artist’s lifetime. Lynes quotes information found on backing labels, and, when noted, from other sources.

cr_data.provenance:
Mrs. Charles H. Davis, New York (unknown date). The artist 1946; Estate of the artist 1986; Georgia O’Keeffe Foundation 1993, gifted 1994 to; LACMA. 
(Source: LACMA, 2025)
remarks_1999: Double entries Whitney Archive. Whitney Archive indicates, "Owned by Miss O'Keeffe. Painted in 1931." An indicates, "Back: Star" [not verified]. Pictured in 1931–32 New York (An American Place) Stieglitz installation photographs, see Appendix III, figures 49, 50. Reproduced and titled *Life and Death* in *New York Herald Tribune* (December 1931); *Life and Death* in *Vanity Fair* (April 1932) [these titles were assigned by Stieglitz]; *Horse's Skull with Pink Rose in *America & Alfred Stieglitz* (1934); *Horse's Head with Pink Rose in *Life* (February 1938); reproduced *PM* (June 1945). (Source: Lynes, 1999)
